title: (No AI) Mark Zuckerberg doesn’t understand how to live
author: Elizabeth Lopatto
content:
![Mark Zuckerberg wearing sunglasses](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/zuckerberg_stock_Parkin.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Recently, a man I was rock climbing with told me about how he'd used AI to make a motivational poster for himself, which he'd hung on his bedroom wall: a bear, walking a slackline over a canyon, holding a sign that said, "Do cool shit." I made what I hoped was a polite noise. What reaction was this man looking for? He probably hoped someone, maybe me, would say it was cool or inspiring. It seemed I was not the first person he'd told about this poster. "You know, it's funny," he said to me. "No one ever says anything about it."

I have been thinking about this now for several days. There's a sort of turducken of things that I find off-puttin …

[Read the full story at The Verge.](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/977623/mark-zuckerberg-ai-manifesto-dim-vision)

title: (No AI) Four takeaways from Mark Zuckerberg’s massive AI manifesto
author: Jess Weatherbed
content:
![Graphic collage of Mark Zuckerberg.](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/chorus/uploads/chorus_asset/file/25546248/STK169_Mark_Zuckerburg_CVIRGINIA_B.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg has a lot to say about the idealized future he now envisions for humanity co-existing with artificial intelligence - his latest essay spans more than 6,500 words on the matter. The lengthy [manifesto Zuckerberg published](https://about.fb.com/news/2026/08/the-future-is-for-everyone/) on Monday, titled "The Future is for Everyone," broadly lays out his beliefs about how the technology should be developed, expanded, and regulated, and how Meta is positioning itself to enable those goals.

Some points echo a similar (albeit, much shorter) public letter that [Zuckerberg put out last year](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/715951/mark-zuckerberg-meta-ai-superintelligence-scale-openai-letter), heralding the importance of public access to superintelligent AI - a term for [artificial general i …](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/845890/ai-companies-rebrand-agi-artificial-general-intelligence)

[Read the full story at The Verge.](https://www.theverge.com/tech/977395/meta-mark-zuckerberg-superintelligent-ai-ramble)
